hooks.command: W=$(command -v witness || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/witness"); [ -x "$W" ] || exit 0; "$W" hook post-tool-use
W=$(command -v witness || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/witness"); [ -x "$W" ] || exit 0; "$W" hook post-tool-use-failure
W=$(command -v witness || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/witness"); [ -x "$W" ] || exit 0; "$W" hook session-end
